inputs.prompt: A man sits in a small meeting room in the late afternoon. He is the only person in the picture. From 0 to 0.8 seconds he looks at a wall screen that is outside the picture, beyond its right edge, reading it with his lips closed. At 0.9 seconds he starts to speak, his eyes still on that screen, and says, quietly impressed, in American English: "His update's already here." Then he turns his head toward a point just beside the camera on its right side, never into the lens, and adds with a small, warm, relaxed smile: "His Peer gave it." His lips move in exact sync with the words and close when he has finished. His eyebrows stay relaxed; his acting is understated and natural, like a real person in a documentary. The camera is locked on a tripod and does not move. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no music, no subtitles and no text.
